instruction: I jotted down some songs in Simple Note recently. Make a playlist titled "Songs from Simple Note" out of it.
notes: Two-app task: read the song list from a Simple Note note, then build a Spotify playlist. The number of songs in the note is only known at runtime; the problem uses 3 placeholder songs (song-1..3) each with its own search query derived from the note content; scale the song/query/count objects to the actual note. 'All songs from the note were added' is encoded without quantifiers via a discrete counter: create_playlist sets the playlist count to count-0, each add_song_to_playlist advances it by one (duplicates blocked by (not (song-in-playlist ?s ?p))), and supervisor-complete-task requires the playlist count to equal the note's song count; since only note-listed songs can obtain known-song-id, reaching the count implies exactly the note's songs are in the playlist, matching the song-in-playlist goal facts. Only one playlist may be created (goal + evaluation require exactly one added Playlist). complete_task takes no answer; its playlist/title/note/count parameters are task records, not API arguments.
